provenance.native: Native StaffRoll resource pointer runs, not one cross-region interpolated array. Function pools anchor logo/name/end tables; script section commands independently select20US,24JP,21EU records whose resource pointers anchor each native section-title pair.
provenance.bounds: Every gfx array ends at maximum actual AnimHeader frame index +1. Nineteen native name runs per region reference only gfx0..2; their following12 Sprite pointers are separate neutral scalar objects, not extra consumed elements. Animation table boundaries require complete renderer headers and the next non-header target.
provenance.unused: US/EU retain one unused Voice Recording variant with the exact8gfx/2animation shape consumed in JP. Other unused name variants preserve the same exact native3animation layout, and are not claimed as selected by the current consumer.
provenance.assets: Each version-local raw target has an exact Sprite or AnimHeader extent and original ROM hash. Localized shapes and changed section lists receive no invented cross-region aliases.
provenance.native_catalog_section: Each existing shared staff-roll catalog already supplies one complete initialized-data run per active region. Ordinary definitions reproduce the same object sequence and native pointer alignment. Only redundant section annotations and corresponding section selectors are removed; types, initializers, object bounds, region guards and encoded assets are unchanged. The catalog grouping is retained as a reconstruction model without asserting an original source filename.
